author: Jessica Tschirdewahn
content: Fantastic service - I hired soft play for my daughter’s birthday. They were super responsive and helpful when booking (unlike some other providers who took days to provide a quote) and very reasonably priced. Despite being based on the other side of London, they delivered/collected the soft play exactly on time and were quick to set up/take it away. The delivery guy was very friendly and efficient. Thoroughly recommend!
